title: From and to, and where you live

sections.title: Origin, home and trips
sections.content: Put 'from' first and 'to' after: *Magyarországról Angliába megyek.* (I am going from Hungary to England.) Ask where someone lives with *Hol laksz?* and answer *Budapesten lakom.* Use *de* to contrast where you are from with where you live: *Angliából vagyok, de Budapesten lakom.* (I am from England, but I live in Budapest.)

items.english: I am going from Hungary to England.
I am from England, but I live in Budapest.

sections.content: The two endings tell the trip: *-ból/-ről* for where you left, *-ba/-be* for where you arrive.
